observations: Photo 0 shows a light/cream 2-seater couch with padded arms and backrest.
Upholstery appears smooth with visible stitching; no obvious major tears seen from this single angle.
No readable brand/model label in the photo.
Seller watermark text is visible but does not identify the product.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not provide a way to confirm usage duration.
Photo 0 has no measuring reference to confirm length.

risks.risk: Condition may be worse than it looks (hidden stains, sagging cushions, worn seams) not visible from one photo/angle.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing the couch from all sides plus close-ups of seams, underside, and seat cushion firmness (press test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used 2-seater sofa with possible wear (worst-case within the provided comparables).

risks.risk: Material type is unclear (could be fabric, faux leather, or genuine leather), affecting value.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the upholstery texture and an edge/corner where material layers are visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used 2-seater couch (not premium leather).

risks.risk: Size/length claim may be inaccurate; smaller couch would reduce value.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo with a measuring tape/yardstick laid along the couch length (arm to arm or end to end).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a standard 2-seater without assuming >4 feet.

proof_requests: Send a video (30–60s) from front, back, both sides, and underside; include close-ups of stitching and any stains.
Show a measuring tape along the couch length to confirm it is over 4 feet.
Confirm upholstery material with close-up texture shots (and an edge/corner).
response.reason: The photo clearly shows a 2-seater couch/sofa, but key claims (3 months used, >4 feet) are not verifiable remotely; pricing should assume typical used condition and generic material.
